timing.complete_call: Complete public susie_rss call with unchanged v030 M2 settings, including all validation/preparation, solver, result construction; inputs loaded before clock; gc and output recording outside clock
timing.fitting: Direct same-call spans, including solver initialization, IBSS/SER, ELBO/convergence, posterior and credible-set result construction; full input/LD preparation and repair excluded
timing.order: Seed20261028, fixed balanced per panel in campaign_plan.json; sequential backends on one lane
timing.clocks: Python perf_counter_ns and Rust Instant; R CLOCK_MONOTONIC shared probe; wall clock start/end also recorded
timing.complete_metric_tradeoff: Both complete and fitting times are measured on timing-instrumented copies; native binary differs from frozen release wheel. Scientific code/settings unchanged; qualification checks observed invariance and describes overhead without a new threshold.
timing.R_boundary: R/susie.R immediately before top-level susie_workhorse call through immediately before final public return
timing.native_boundary: Four explicit native initialization/solver spans, native output export, then Python finalization until public return; exact patch and boundary documentation retained
timing.boundary_limits: Implicit native Gram scaling inside solver matvec remains fit work; R scaled Gram construction occurs in preparation. Minor scalar initialization checks and final-CS submatrix normalization remain included as documented. Tiny native span transitions are omitted. No separately measured cost subtraction.

environment.node_selection: Available authorized cpunode hosts; CPU/AVX2 and topology verified on each allocation before timing; actual node list in per-node topology records and ledger
environment.lanes: One physical core per L3 domain; last L3 domain reserved for node coordinator. Other physical cores and SMT siblings in each timing domain idle.
environment.numa: numactl --membind and --physcpubind; localalloc fallback only if actual membind probe fails, recorded per lane
environment.diagnostics: Per-node Slurm/topology/numactl metadata, governor/frequency/load/memory every15seconds; per-call timestamps and per-process VmHWM diagnostic only
environment.memory: Reservation max(2GiB,1.5*v030 measured peak,4*LD bytes); sum<=90% node MemTotal; large LD>1GiB at most4concurrent/socket. Estimates, not hard memory guarantees.

queue_details: Flatten predeclared plan shards and sort descending local planning seconds then case key; atomic complete-file hardlink claims prevent duplicate admission across nodes. Completed records bind current protocol; stale/failed claims require explicit operational disposition. Node queue drained does not imply full panel complete.
walltime_admission: Only admit when remaining allocation seconds>=max(180,3*old complete-case estimate+120). Deferred unclaimed cases remain in global queue for another allocation; this does not truncate the run.

ld_policy.source: 1000G-derived strict QC genotype reference strict_snp_maf05_v1 already on burgundy under /home/wjiang49/prusie_project/data/prusie_realdata_r13_v11/reference/strict_snp_maf05_v1 (SHA256-verified transfer 20261023); transfer only missing or mismatched genotype files
ld_policy.reconstruction: per case on the compute node before timing with PLINK (user amendment 20261028; the original Python construction code is no longer required), using the frozen variant list, order and allele alignment, node-local storage, deleted after the case
ld_policy.tool: PLINK 1.9 or PLINK 2, signed r (not r^2), full square matrix, double-precision binary output, one thread

fidelity.asymmetry_change: 22of24 originals have tiny nonzero asymmetry; all24PLINK outputs exactly symmetric. This may alter native validation allocation; host-interference attribution is confounded by LD arithmetic.

staging: All required archives and authenticated genotype triplets copied to node-local storage before lane timing starts. Each case PLINK LD built before fits and removed after both backends; archive/serialization outside timed calls.
failures: Only operational node/OOM/preemption failures may rerun whole case with identical settings after explicit ledger entry; never timing/numerical outcome reruns; preserve failed attempts; every fixed case stays in denominator.
